about: How a day is named at the start of a scene (owner, Nov 8, 2:20 p.m.: 'If it's June 7th, it says first thing on June 7th. You head to the clerk's office and speak to Maria Patton.'): the part of the day and the date as people say it, 'first thing on June 7th'. Read by src/english/day-words.ts; the director passes the date and the minute of the day.
sinceAbout: A record's own day told as past from the day a scene plays (pool item words-day-end-scene-opens-next-midnight): 'yesterday', 'the other day', 'on January 3rd'; never a weekday, since a scene's opening names no weekday (owner, Oct 26: "it shouldn't say ... it's Tuesday in November"; src/director/scene.test.ts). Read by daySince in src/english/day-words.ts; the scene passes it to its lines as the fact since, which a sentence may use.
